summary: Tested per-instance LLM provider feature (multi-provider: emergent/anthropic/ollama). 15/15 new pytest cases pass for backend. 51/51 scripted regression tests still pass (refactor confirmed behavior-preserving). Frontend BotSettings LLM Provider card structurally verified: all data-testids present, 3 provider options, conditional fields show/hide correctly, allowlist of 3 anthropic models, save+test buttons functional, test-result chip renders.

integration_issues.issue: When admin lands on /admin/settings WITHOUT having selected an instance via the sidebar workspace switcher, the LLM Provider card still renders and lets the user click Save/Test, but every API call is sent to /api/admin/instances/undefined/llm-config (400/404). Toast error fires, but the form looks active. Same problem applies to the rest of Bot Settings (bot-config save would also fail silently). Fix: gate the whole Bot Settings page behind a 'pick an instance first' empty state, OR auto-select the first instance on login. The backend wiring & masked-preview logic are correct — verified end-to-end via curl/pytest.

action_items: (Optional UX polish) Gate Bot Settings page when no instance selected — show a 'Select a workspace first' empty state instead of rendering inert forms. Not blocking — backend & UI conditional rendering all correct.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3018 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Splitting into modules (llm_provider.py, scripted_router.py, discord.py, admin.py) would improve maintainability. Not blocking for this feature.

Anthropic exception handling in _call_anthropic catches AuthenticationError + RateLimitError, but a generic Anthropic API error (e.g., model_not_found from the API, 5xx) would propagate as a 500 from the call_claude wrapper without specific context. Consider adding `except _anthropic.APIError` for nicer messages. Minor.
GET /llm-config returns the masked preview only when len(key) > 12; shorter keys get an empty preview but anthropic_api_key_set still reflects truth — acceptable.

BotSettings.js: when provider changes via dropdown the form state doesn't persist the typed-but-unsaved anthropic_api_key vs ollama_base_url separately — switching from anthropic → ollama → anthropic would not lose data because they live in separate state slots. Verified OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (structural + interactive); 1 minor UX gating issue noted

seed_data_creation: Uses first existing instance from /api/admin/instances list; restores provider=emergent at end of test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All LLM-provider backend behavior validated via /app/backend/tests/test_llm_provider.py — unit (allowlist size, _resolve_llm_config default, _call_anthropic raises on empty/bogus key) + HTTP (GET/PUT/test endpoints w/ auth, masking, preservation, model/provider validation, graceful failure on bad keys & unreachable Ollama). The /test endpoint with provider=emergent succeeded against the real Emergent key and returned 'pong'. Frontend conditional rendering (emergent=free-text/anthropic=dropdown+key/ollama=URL) all confirmed by data-testid presence checks. Only caveat: full UI 'save→reload→masked-preview-appears-in-placeholder' flow could not be tested via Playwright because admin lands on /admin with no instance selected (sidebar shows 'Select workspace'), which makes BotSettings call /admin/instances/undefined/...; the masking logic itself is verified server-side by test_put_anthropic_with_key_and_mask_preview and the BotSettings.js code at line 206 wires it correctly: placeholder={llm.anthropic_api_key_set ? `Current: ${llm.anthropic_api_key_preview} — leave blank to keep` : 'sk-ant-…'}.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Single non-blocking observation: BotSettings page renders without guarding on selectedInstance, causing silent 400/404s on Save/Test when admin hasn't picked an instance via the sidebar workspace switcher. This is pre-existing app behavior (affects all Bot Settings tabs), not introduced by the LLM Provider feature.
